hero.title: Day of Science — Discover, Experiment, Be Curious
hero.subtitle: An open day to explore research, meet scientists, and join hands-on activities for all ages.
hero.card: Hands-on demos, talks, and family-friendly workshops across many scientific disciplines.
about.title: About the Day of Science
about.lead: Every year we open our doors to everyone interested in science: students, families, and curious minds. Discover ongoing research, try experiments, and chat with researchers.
about.mission: To make science accessible and engaging, stimulate curiosity, and inspire the next generation of researchers.
about.audience: Everyone: families, students, teachers, and people who just like to ask questions and experiment.
program.title: Program
program.lead: A packed program of talks, guided tours and interactive sessions. Highlights include:
program.activity1.title: CTF: Campus Challenge
program.activity1.desc: A fun Capture The Flag competition — solve puzzles, hack challenges, and win prizes.
program.activity2.title: Robotics Workshop
program.activity2.desc: Build and program a small robot. Hands-on session for beginners.
program.activity3.title: Chemistry Magic Show
program.activity3.desc: Color-changing reactions and safe demos that amaze.
program.activity4.title: Stargazing Night
program.activity4.desc: Guided telescope session and constellation tour (outdoor).
program.activity5.title: BioLab: DNA extraction
program.activity5.desc: Extract DNA from fruit and see it with your own eyes.
program.activity6.title: Kids' Science Circus
program.activity6.desc: Interactive experiments for children with parental guidance.
practical.title: Practical information
practical.lead: Free entry, accessible campus. Public transport stops nearby — check our travel page for details.
practical.transport: By train/bus: Hasselt station and local buses
practical.accessibility: Wheelchair accessible venues — contact us for assistance
